requiredFindings.title: Evidence cut-off and request publication disagree with E196’s actual publication
requiredFindings.evidence: E196 and its recordedEvidence correctly name fbb8545668049ce8756a4e77b8e42565fbefd718 (2026-10-14T00:45:21-07:00), which published the eight-set U-2b ACCEPT. REQUEST.md instead assigns E196 publication 37643eb02a91262abc31861fca30006bc56f1067, and the board/source cutoff names that later commit. Git identifies 37643eb as the accepted overlay-entry follow-on (2026-10-14T00:50:55-07:00), with codex-sm-u2b-entry8-r1 ACCEPT and the ninth set. The current register nevertheless says the overlay set follows and includes only the original U-2b authority.
requiredFindings.impact: The eight-set record is accurately scoped, but the stated evidence head already contains a second acceptance that resolves the displayed pending work. The request’s E196 publication mapping is also inaccurate.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Keep E196 bound to its actual fbb8545668049ce8756a4e77b8e42565fbefd718 publication and correct the request. For this one-record reconciliation, use that commit as the substantive evidence cutoff and clearly retain overlay-pending status as of that cutoff; the checkout base may remain the later HEAD. Alternatively submit an expanded reconciliation that separately records the overlay follow-on, its review/subject/assent and updated next action/counts. Regenerate subject pins and submit the corrected exact snapshot; do not broaden E196’s accepted eight-set scope or rerun inherited validation.
